assets.visualReview: Exactly one connected molecular-model-like subject is visible, but it contains twenty-eight graphite centers and five rose centers, thirty-three heavy-atom centers overall rather than the required twenty-five carbon, five oxygen, and thirty total. The left ester-side branch includes an extra graphite branching pattern and the full graph does not reconcile with the frozen neutral-simvastatin connectivity. The raster also has a transparent canvas with broad graphite and rose glow or haze instead of the required opaque pale field.
assets.quarantineReason: The native output fails both scientific graph and visual-field requirements. It adds three carbon-like centers overall, so it is not neutral simvastatin. It also contains 1,372,776 fully transparent pixels, 200,088 intermediate-alpha pixels, zero fully opaque pixels, and 452 nonzero-alpha pixels in the outer 32-pixel band. These failures cannot be repaired without replacing the generated evidence.
